newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shanghai Petrochem to place shares in U.S., Canada.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Petrochem to place shares in U.S., Canada.

text.p: Shanghai Petrochemical Co Ltd said trading of its shares in Hong Kong was suspended on Friday as it entered into an agreement to place American depositary shares in the United States and Canada.
Placing and underwriting of the shares would be done by Peregrine Brokerage Inc, the late Friday statement said.
It would apply for trade to resume at 10 a.m. (0200 GMT) next Tuesday.

Shanghai Petrochemical, which delayed the share placement plan last month, said on Friday it would place 500 million H shares, or 7.1 percent of the enlarged share capital, globally at HK$2.075 each to institutional and professional investors.
The company said it intended to use the net proceeds to finance, in part, its capital expansion, and as working capital.
Its shares rose HK$0.05 to end at HK$2.25 on Thursday.
